message: You know that feeling when you’re in the middle of a great campfire story and suddenly realize you forgot the marshmallows? 😅 Well, being prepared for home fires can feel a bit like that too! Check out this handy resource on fire safety — it's all about keeping your home cozy and ready, minus the panic. Just like a good camping trip, it’s always better when you’re prepared!
